speaker: alice
text: Let's kick off with the environment, and it is peak whale season along our coast right now. Mumma humpbacks and their calves are being spotted rolling and breaching off the Sunshine Coast as they make their way back south.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah I saw the photos, absolute units cruising past like they own the joint, which fair enough, they kind of do. Meanwhile down in Moreton Bay, volunteers have been out planting seagrass seedlings to help the dugongs and turtles get a proper feed.

speaker: alice
text: It is such a simple thing, planting a few thousand seedlings, but it makes a massive difference to that whole ecosystem. Two great reminders that a healthy bay and a healthy coastline go hand in hand.
